title: TMS Airing Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for TMS broadcast airing entities

structure.startTime: string — ISO 8601 datetime of scheduled start (UTC)
structure.endTime: string — ISO 8601 datetime of scheduled end (UTC)
structure.channel: string — Channel number as displayed on lineup
structure.qualifiers: array<string> — Airing attributes [New, Live, Finale, Repeat, Premiere, HD, SAP]

qualifierMeaning.New: First airing of a new episode
qualifierMeaning.Repeat: Re-airing of a previously broadcast episode

notes: All times are expressed in UTC; clients should convert to local timezone
Duration may differ slightly from endTime - startTime due to broadcast overruns
Grid endpoint returns up to 6 hours per request, up to 14 days advance
